GOV_PO_3_APPROVED_MOVEMENT_ORCHESTRATION.md (FROZEN) engineer permission profile. Loaded only via `claude -p --settings .claude/nexus-engineer.settings.json` by scripts/orchestrator.py when it spawns an engineer process in its own worktree -- never used by an interactively-started engineer session, which needs no such profile. Default-allow (normal dev tools: Read/Edit/Write/Bash/Git), distinct from .claude/nexus-po.settings.json's default-deny shape -- see scripts/nexus_engineer_tool_gate.py's own module docstring for the two narrow boundaries this profile actually gates. The canonical relay directory (section 3.6) is NOT listed under permissions.additionalDirectories here because its absolute path is per-checkout, not something this committed file can hold; scripts/orchestrator.py::_spawn_engineer passes it as `--add-dir <canonical_relay_dir>` on every spawn instead (relay/NXS-LOCAL-0015 AC-2/AC-3) -- the CLI-flag equivalent of the same grant, computed at dispatch/resume time, applied identically to a fresh dispatch and a resume. permissions.allow (Edit/Write/MultiEdit) added 2026-09-08 (orchestrator_background_task_exit_race batch, live finding on NXS-LOCAL-0020/NXS-LOCAL-0018): under --permission-prompts none, any tool call that would otherwise prompt for approval is auto-denied, and absent an explicit allow entry this silently denied EVERY Edit/Write call all along -- every successful movement to date only ever wrote files via Bash. This entry makes the profile's own 'default-allow' claim actually true.
GOV.ORCH.3 note: a tool-neutral git-level gate now also exists (a per-worktree `pre-push` hook, scripts/nexus_worker_prepush.py, installed by scripts/orchestrator.py at dispatch) -- this profile's hooks are unchanged and still apply to interactive Claude sessions.
